answers.hauptleistung: Development of SaaS solutions for B2B clients, including custom software development, API integrations, cloud infrastructure setup, and technical consulting for digital transformation projects.
answers.ki_projekte: Implemented GitHub Copilot across the team, built custom AI-powered code review bots, automated documentation generation from code comments, and developed an internal knowledge base with AI search capabilities. Currently experimenting with AI-assisted testing frameworks.
answers.zeitersparnis_prioritaet: Code reviews consume significant team time, along with writing technical documentation, debugging complex issues, and responding to repetitive customer support tickets. Onboarding new developers also requires substantial documentation effort.
answers.geschaeftsmodell_evolution: Transitioning from project-based work to product-focused SaaS offerings with AI-enhanced features. Building reusable components and frameworks that accelerate delivery while maintaining quality.
answers.vision_3_jahre: Become a recognized AI-first development agency delivering intelligent SaaS solutions. Scale the team while maintaining quality through AI-augmented workflows, automated testing, and smart documentation systems.
answers.strategische_ziele: Ship faster with fewer bugs, reduce technical debt through AI-assisted refactoring, build a strong product portfolio, establish thought leadership in AI-enhanced development practices, and create scalable client delivery processes.
